notes.title: Beta 1.3.3 - Balancing, Bug Fixes, and much more!
notes.content:
Got some things you will love to read in this new update! We decided to give our players some grace while dealing with the bosses of the game. Let’s get into this update!

[b]New[/b]  
Added an absolute health system! Depending on the difficulty, there will always be health spawning before you go to face a boss! Not only that, but there are also two new health kits! They are specific to Player 1 and Player 2, so you don’t have to worry about your fully healed friend hogging all the health! They also last longer than normal health kits, ensuring you can grab them before they disappear!

[b]Changes[/b]  
- Enemies have calmed down in endless mode! No longer will you have to deal with three enemies at once—at least for now...  

- The Spireworm’s weak point will now flash yellow, indicating that this is the best spot to shoot first.  

- You can now counter the Spireworm’s head color change. Reducing its health by 5 points—through repeated hits—will change its head color back to green, opening it up to more attacks!  

- The Spireworm’s healing doesn’t restore as much health now.  

- Turning the Spireworm’s weak point to green will cause that segment to drop enough health to fully heal you—if you can collect it all, that is!  

- Health kits will now flash when they are about to disappear.

[b]Fixes[/b]  
- The U.F.O. is no longer invincible when playing as it.  

- Player 2 Spaceman will now use the Space Trials healing sound.

And that’s it for now for the game. As for the OST, you can now listen to all of the tracks in the game here!

https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL5uk5Zjp9IZJkFtlWM2gLM4eNorgkFfCU


[b][u]afcai rfc bcqapgnrgmlq[/u][/b]  

Huh? What the heck was that? Hmm, anyway, enjoy the music!

notes.title: Beta 1.3.2 - Spireworm's Last Trick
notes.content:
We said the Spireworm wasn't done, and we meant it! This jerk now has minions... Great. Why did Jillkoy have to make his monsters so awful to fight? I mean, I get that he's evil, it's just... [b]Never-mind[/b]. Let's just get to the list.

[b]Added[/b]
- [b]New Spireworm attack! [/b] If the Spireworm’s head turns red, shooting its segments will cause the very end to drop our newest enemy.

- [b]The Spireminion![/b] These detached segments will shoot spikes in your direction—because you clearly didn’t have enough to dodge already! You can get rid of them by either shooting them directly or killing the Spireworm.

- [b]New visual settings![/b] You can now change how space looks in any way you like. Don’t like the stars? Turn them off! Don’t like the nebula? TURN them off! Don’t like the planets? TURN THEM off! Do you just not like anything simtendo added to the background? TURN THEM OFF!!!

[b]Changes[/b]
- Destroying the Spireworm’s weak point will immediately turn its head red. This guy really does not want to be friends, does he?

-The Spireworm no longer stays on one head color for an annoyingly long time. He’s still going to be annoying, though…

And that’s it for this update! Other than bug fixes, we’re now going to focus on our next major—48m9ufvm8uf4wkjfcmnrdsewiocfv Incoming U.B.O

notes.title: Update Beta 1.3.1 Valentines Patch
notes.content:
Added some more neat features to the Spireworm update! Happy Valentine’s Day to all the couples out there! Us single people will continue not having a Player 2. :,( Anyway, let's get to these new changes!

Patch Changes

- Added a weak point to the Spireworm! Hate his spike explosions? So do we! We've given him a red segment weak point. If you can turn that segment green before destroying it, you'll completely disable his spike explosion and spike shotgun attacks! But if you destroy it without turning it green... well... good luck.

- The Spireworm can now heal! If his health drops below 10 or his weak point is destroyed, he can turn his head blue! Shooting his segments while his head is this color will heal him and restore segments—so try not to do that!

- Added the Spireship! A new unlockable ship you can get by defeating the Spireworm on Nightmare mode! That weak point is sounding pretty useful now, isn’t it?

- Added the Valentine Ship! A new heart-shaped ship that unlocks when you pass wave 20 in Endless mode! Be sure to grab that one for your special someone! This ship can only be unlocked from February 14th to the 20th, so don’t miss out!

- Added a new red shader! This shader flashes when you're landing bad hits—like shooting the Dashark while his mouth is closed or attacking the Spireworm when he has a healing head!

More features are on the way soon—the Spireworm still has a few tricks up his... sleeves? Uh, segments!

notes.title: Beta 1.3.0 The Spireworm Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the first major update to Galaxy Hassle, The Spireworm Update! This update adds a new mini missions mode (unlocked once you beat the campaign) with a whole new set of enemies and a new boss.


[b]Major Changes[/b]

- First mini mission, "Spireworm Crawls," added (Expect to see more missions added in the future).

- Minitern is now classed as a common enemy.

- Added the Jestern, a jester-like Grimtern that shoots small blue fireballs in your direction.

- Added the Gleevile, a frog-like enemy that will swim down the screen and try to attack you from the sides once they pass you.

- Added the Dashark, a dashing shark that cannot be hurt until he opens his mouth for a bite. Plus, if you shoot him while his mouth is closed, he picks up speed for when he does open his mouth.

- Added the Spireworm, the first ever segmented enemy added to the game! This jerk will fight you till its very last breath, whether it's by trying to catch you between its segments, or by firing spikes at you! Do you have what it takes to take down this monster?

- Added Nightmare Tracks! "Spireworm Crawls" receives a nightmare variation to the already existing track. Get ready to hear some adrenaline rush-inducing music in nightmare mode (only in Spireworm Crawls for now)!

[b]Minor Changes[/b]

- Grimtern will now heal you by 5 health points upon death.

- Grodel will now blink when you shoot them.

- Updated the game's typeface.

- New alert sounds added for players, starting when you have 4 health left. The lower your health, the faster and higher-pitched the sounds are.

- Added Valentine's Day splashes, which will show up on February 14th. There are a total of 14 splashes!

- Endless mode is now unlockable when you beat Spireworm Crawls.

- Spaceman's hitbox adjusted.

- Main menu has been repositioned to be more centered to the screen.

- Fixed inability to go to the main menu when using a controller after completing a mission/campaign.

- Grimtern's death points now multiply based on the difficulty.
